svg.title: Lessons from your own video, system context
svg.desc: The app asks the API for a lesson; the GPU runner on the DGX screens the video with Gemini, reconstructs 3D motion with ball tracking, writes and checks the lesson, and publishes a private bundle the app downloads directly from Supabase.
